title: Flag
description: A 'may be worth asking about' flag produced only by deterministic code in /core. Never produced by the LLM. reason and basis must never contain banned words (see product.md).

line_item_id.description: id of the LineItem this flag refers to. Must reference a real line item.

flag_type.description: Which deterministic check produced this flag.

severity.description: Relative priority for display ordering only. Not a judgement of wrongdoing.

reason.description: Plain-language explanation in the 'may be worth asking about' voice. No banned words.

basis.description: The concrete data that triggered the flag (e.g. the reference figure and its source/year, or the duplicated rows).

data_source.description: Required when the flag cites a price figure; otherwise null.

data_year.description: Required when the flag cites a price figure; otherwise null.
